text: The casein is already dissolved in alkali as a thick paste; the arrow adds what makes a label adhesive: extenders, resin, alcohol and additives that tune tack and viscosity.

steps.note: The casein is given water-soluble extenders (fillers that bulk it out), resin derivatives and an alcohol, often with urea, borax, an antifoam and a preservative.
